ValidationRule.description: for IMLA SC profiles, follow up and pending reason to be mandatory when status is On Hold - Internal
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( $Profile.Name = "IMLA_SC_Representative", $Profile.Name = "IMLA_SC_Manager", $Profile.Name = "IMLA_SC_In_Country_Admin" ), OR( ISBLANK(Follow_up_Date__c), ISBLANK(Text(NAS_Pending_Reason__c)) ), ISPICKVAL(Status, "On Hold - Internal") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add a Follow Up Date and Pending Reason when placing case On Hold - Internal
